fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Whirls a cloud of spines around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stripping 12% of their armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 15%. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Strip to the Stalk
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Flicks a barb that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spined Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of spined insects for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage to an enemy within 6 tiles every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorged on the Field
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
